fundamentals.name: Astera Labs, Inc.
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Astera Labs, Inc. designs, manufactures, and sells semiconductor-based connectivity solutions for cloud and AI infrastructure in Taiwan and the United States. It offers an intelligent connectivity platform, comprised of semiconductor-based, high-speed, mixed-signal connectivity products that integrate a matrix of microcontrollers and sensors, and COSMOS. The company provides COSMOS software suite, a connectivity system management and optimization software that enables management and optimization of resources for large fleets at cloud-scale via link, fleet, and RAS management capabilities. In addition, it offers PCIe/CXL smart DSP retimers and cable modules; ethernet smart cable modules for cloud and AI infrastructure; CXL memory connectivity controllers; and smart fabric switches. The company serves hyperscalers and system original equipment manufacturers. Astera Labs, Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is based in San Jose, California.

judgment.summary: Rapidly growing company with strong margins and a leading position in AI infrastructure, though valuation metrics are stretched.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last quarter beat EPS estimates by 13.5%; next earnings date is 2026-08-04.
positives: Revenue growth 93.4% YoY and Earnings growth 144.4% YoY indicate strong top- and bottom-line expansion.
Gross margin of 76.0% and Profit margin of 26.7% demonstrate excellent operational efficiency.
Quarterly earnings beat estimates by 13.5% in the last report.
Strong balance sheet with a current ratio of 11.30 and a quick ratio of 10.55.
Significant analyst support with 22 buy ratings and a high growth estimate for the current fiscal year.
negatives: Valuation metrics such as Trailing P/E of 253.40 and Forward P/E of 88.55 are exceptionally high.
Price/Book of 42.71 and Price/Sales of 63.76 also suggest a premium valuation.
Debt/Equity ratio of 2.80 is notable, although offset by strong cash and current ratios.
Analyst mean target of $244.97 is significantly below the current spot price, indicating a divergence.

news.paragraph: Astera Labs (ALAB) is gaining significant attention following its inclusion in the Nasdaq-100 index. This news follows closely on the heels of the company expanding its Scorpio Network Switch portfolio with the high-performance X-Series 320 and a bullish analyst report from RBC setting a new high price target. The company is positioning itself as a key player in the AI infrastructure space, with analysts highlighting its role in building the 'nervous system' for AI racks.
